'''2015 European Championship''' was the Players Committee European Championship at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany, 16–18 October 2015. [[Ziemowit Skwara]] finished 1st in Day 3. Wrap labels Day 3 as Day 2 and Day 2 as Day 1; stages follow the tournament-decklists accordion.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-european-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 16–18 October 2015
* '''Winner:''' [[Ziemowit Skwara]]
